stops.name: Mount Ochsenkopf
stops.quote: Around Mount Ochsenkopf and Saubadfelsen, several hundred kilometres of trails and cross-country tracks await cross-country skiers, tourers and snowshoe hikers in addition to four kilometres of pistes.
stops.english: Around Mount Ochsenkopf and Saubadfelsen, several hundred kilometres of trails and cross-country tracks await cross-country skiers, tourers and snowshoe hikers in addition to four kilometres of pistes.

stops.name: Saubadfelsen
stops.quote: A few snowdrifts and stream crossings later, we laboriously scrambled up the icy steps to the viewing platform at Saubadfelsen.
stops.english: A few snowdrifts and stream crossings later, we laboriously scrambled up the icy steps to the viewing platform at Saubadfelsen.

stops.name: Zipfeltannenfelsen
stops.quote: Last winter would almost have passed without a trip to Ochsenkopf and Zipfeltannenfelsen if Schorsch hadn't called me on a Wednesday shortly before April 1st.
stops.english: Last winter would almost have passed without a trip to Ochsenkopf and Zipfeltannenfelsen if Schorsch hadn't called me on a Wednesday shortly before April 1st.

stops.name: Steinwald Nature Park
stops.quote: Three to four lynx appear from time to time in the photo traps in the Steinwald Nature Park, but because their hunting grounds cover up to 400 square kilometres, it would be almost impossible to encounter a lynx.
stops.english: Three to four lynx appear from time to time in the photo traps in the Steinwald Nature Park, but because their hunting grounds cover up to 400 square kilometres, it would be almost impossible to encounter a lynx.

stops.name: Saubadloipe
stops.quote: The forest history trail that Jonas wants to show me starts just a few minutes’ walk away at the entrance to the Saubadloipe (Saubad ski trail).
stops.english: The forest history trail that Jonas wants to show me starts just a few minutes’ walk away at the entrance to the Saubadloipe (Saubad ski trail).

stops.name: red deer enclosure
stops.quote: We continue towards the red deer enclosure, the last point of the hike.
stops.english: We continue towards the red deer enclosure, the last point of the hike.

stops.name: Fichtelsee
stops.quote: At lake Fichtelsee just outside the village of Fichtelberg, the car park is framed by snowy mountains.
stops.english: At lake Fichtelsee just outside the village of Fichtelberg, the car park is framed by snowy mountains.

stops.name: Klausenhang
stops.quote: The first snow falls shortly beforehand on Mehlmeisel’s Klausenhang, a 700-metre-long snow-covered ribbon opposite the Ochsenkopf where skiers and tobogganers whizz downhill and which has floodlights.
stops.english: The first snow falls shortly beforehand on Mehlmeisel’s Klausenhang, a 700-metre-long snow-covered ribbon opposite the Ochsenkopf where skiers and tobogganers whizz downhill and which has floodlights.

stops.name: Weißmain-Ochsenkopf-Steig
stops.quote: Via well-marked winter hiking trails, we walk on touring skis through deeply snow-covered forest to the Weißmain-Ochsenkopf-Steig trail, crossing cross-country ski trails with cross-country skiers who emit clouds of breath like steam locomotives.
stops.english: Via well-marked winter hiking trails, we walk on touring skis through deeply snow-covered forest to the Weißmain-Ochsenkopf-Steig trail, crossing cross-country ski trails with cross-country skiers who emit clouds of breath like steam locomotives.

stops.name: Felsendach
stops.quote: At some point we take a tea break at the so-called Felsendach, a bench below large granite boulders not far from the source of the Fichtelnaab, which Schorsch had recommended to me: “You won’t find better water, it’ll shoot you right to the top.”
stops.english: At some point we take a tea break at the so-called Felsendach, a bench below large granite boulders not far from the source of the Fichtelnaab, which Schorsch had recommended to me: “You won’t find better water, it’ll shoot you right to the top.”
